description: This file contains implementations related to process management and error handling for the 'angel' component of the 'lighttpd' server, including pipe setup, process creation, and cleanup functions.

classes.name: liErrorPipe
classes.description: Represents an error pipe used for inter-process communication, managing file descriptors and associated callbacks.

classes.name: liProc
classes.description: Represents a managed process, encapsulating process ID, associated error pipe, application name, and server context.

methods.name: void read_pipe(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,gboolean flush)
methods.description: Reads data from the error pipe until EOF or an error occurs, optionally flushing the buffer.

methods.name: void error_pipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is available on the error pipe, triggering a read operation.

methods.name: liErrorPipe * li_error_pipe_new(liServer * srv,liErrorPipeCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new error pipe with specified server context, callback, and user data.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_free(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with an error pipe.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_activate(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Activates the error pipe for reading errors by closing the out-fd and starting event watching.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_use(liErrorPipe * epipe,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Redirects the in-fd of the error pipe to a specified file descriptor, closing the original in-fd.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_flush(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Flushes remaining data in the error pipe.

methods.name: void proc_epipe_cb(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,GString * msg)
methods.description: Callback that logs backend lines when an error message is received on the error pipe.

methods.name: liProc * li_proc_new(liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates a new process, sets up necessary environment and user privileges, forks, and executes the specified command.

methods.name: void li_proc_free(liProc * proc)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a process, including its error pipe.

ctags.name: li_proc_new
ctags.pattern: /^liProc* li_proc_new(liServer *srv, gchar **args, gchar **env, uid_t uid, gid_t gid, gchar *usern/
ctags.signature: (liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
